workerContracts.scope: Actual background planning with original production URDF, collision checks, MuJoCo and planner. Worker heartbeat validates event-loop isolation, not browser FPS. No physics gate is relaxed and no historical report is rebound.

ordinarySort.planningScope: Production background controller with real worker_threads bridge and shipped worker service/parser/serialization; workers are polled asynchronously between complete global 1 ms ticks. Every world time/qpos/qvel/ctrl is asserted unchanged during planning. No task motion is executed in a worker.

multiAcceptance.scope: Current-source numerical, orchestration, static UI, framing, responsiveness and publication-path acceptance; not rendered-browser or hardware acceptance
unverified: Desktop/mobile rendered appearance and camera pixels

pipeAcceptance.scope: Current-source numerical pipe-classification acceptance; not rendered-browser or real-hardware certification
unverified: Rendered desktop/mobile pixels and native pointer/touch interactions
